description: This donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually represents the comparative win rates of two models, GPT-4o and LLaMA, as presented in the paper “Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models”. The chart is composed of two distinct slices: a smaller, dark red segment labeled “GPT-4o: 12.0%” and a larger, light blue segment labeled “LLaMA: 80.4%”. The chart includes a legend that associates the dark red color with GPT-4o and the light blue with LLaMA, and percentage values are explicitly labeled next to each corresponding slice. The central white area contains the title, and the overall structure is a ring chart with a hollow center. The slices are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, with the larger LLaMA segment occupying the majority of the chart.
